Metadata.title: Findelio – Find businesses that speak your language
Metadata.description: Switzerland’s multilingual business directory. Find businesses by language, industry, canton and location.

Home.title: Find businesses that speak your language.
Home.description: Search by language, industry and location to find suitable businesses near you.
Home.howDescription: Find the right business in three simple steps.
Home.step1Text: Select the language in which you would like to receive advice.
Home.step2Text: Narrow the search by industry, canton and location.
Home.step3Text: Compare listings and get in touch directly.
Home.ctaTitle: Does your business speak several languages?
Home.ctaText: Create a listing and get found by the right customers.

Register.title: Make your business visible.
Register.description: Enter the key details. The listing will be reviewed before publication.
Register.note: This version does not store data permanently yet. The form already shows the planned workflow.
Register.successText: The details were successfully validated in this demo. Database integration follows in the next development step.

Login.title: Sign in to Findelio
Login.description: Sign in to manage your businesses and listings.
Login.note: Your credentials are securely verified through Directus.
Login.errorFallback: The email address or password is incorrect.
Login.serverError: Sign-in cannot be processed at the moment.
Login.connectionError: The connection to the server failed.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard
Dashboard.description: Manage your businesses, listings and team members here.
Dashboard.organizationsDescription: View all organizations where you have an active membership and their associated business listings.
Dashboard.noOrganizationsDescription: Your user account is not currently assigned to an active organization. Check the membership in Directus or contact an administrator.
Dashboard.noListings: No business listing has been created for this organization yet.

listingsPage.title: Your business listings
listingsPage.description: View all listings belonging to your active organizations and their current publication status.
listingsPage.emptyDescription: No business listing has been created for your active organizations yet.
listingsPage.notPublic: This listing is not publicly visible yet.

teamPage.title: Team
teamPage.description: Manage the members and roles of your organizations here.
teamPage.nextStepTitle: Team management is the next step
teamPage.nextStepDescription: You can currently see your own active memberships. Invitations and management of additional team members will be added securely in the next step.

Footer.tagline: Findelio connects people with businesses that speak their language.

Legal.imprintText: Before publication, add the operator’s complete legal details required under Swiss law.
Legal.privacyText: Before publication, add a complete privacy policy covering hosting, forms, analytics and third-party services.

ListingEditor.title: Edit {name}
ListingEditor.description: Update your business profile. Changes can be saved as a draft or submitted for review.
ListingEditor.industryHint: Select all industries in which the business operates.
ListingEditor.spokenLanguagesHint: Select all languages in which the business serves customers.
ListingEditor.statusHint: Profiles submitted for review can then be checked and published.
